title: Virtual bucket registry
description: The virtual-buckets.json file of a user: the folders opened as virtual buckets, the labels of buckets, and the root folder where new virtual buckets are made.

format_version.description: Version of the layout of the file. An implementation refuses a version greater than the one it knows.

root.description: Absolute path of the folder where new virtual buckets are made, as the operating system writes paths, or null when none is set.

buckets.description: One entry per bucket that has a label. A bucket appears at most once.

label.description: The user's own name for the bucket.

folders.description: One entry per recorded folder. A path appears at most once.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder, as the operating system writes paths.

bucket.description: Name of the bucket the folder stood for when it was last recorded.

prefix.description: Prefix the folder stood for when it was last recorded, in the form of bucket.json.

pinned.description: Whether the user pinned the folder to the top of the list.

last_opened.description: When the folder was last opened, in UTC, or null when it was recorded without being opened.
